observations: Hero image shows a wide cityscape photograph of Riverside with palm trees and mountains at sunset, with large white outlined text 'welcome To Dentist Near Me Riverside' overlaid
Logo design features a blue tooth icon inside a location pin marker with 'Riverside DENTIST NEAR ME' in bright cyan blue and 'General & Implant Dentistry' tagline underneath
Top navigation bar is bright cyan blue with white text links (HOME, ABOUT, SERVICES, TECHNOLOGY, GALLERY, OFFERS, PRICING, REVIEWS, NEW PATIENTS, CONTACT) spanning full width
Header area includes gold star rating display with 'See Our Reviews' link, gray buttons for 'Español' and 'Request An Appointment', and phone number 951-777-2825 in cyan

Mobile version maintains the same hero image and layout proportions well, with navigation collapsed to a bottom sticky bar showing Menu, Reviews, Call Now, and Appointment icons, and the hero text remains readable though slightly smaller

rationales.visualCraft: Lightly customized template with stock cityscape photography, basic logo design, and standard cyan color scheme applied throughout but no distinctive custom elements or real practice photography visible
rationales.clarityHierarchy: Practice name and phone number are prominent, CTA buttons are visible in header, but the generic 'Dentist Near Me' branding and multiple competing CTAs create adequate but unremarkable hierarchy
rationales.modernity: Clean flat design with large hero image and contemporary layout structure looks current enough (2019-2021 era), but the bright cyan color scheme and generic stock photography feel standard rather than distinctive
